title: MIDI file
description: Reads a Standard MIDI File of the project and gives its notes, so that an instrument block can play them. It needs a .mid file; it can also give the audio of a built-in rendering.

parameters.name: file
parameters.doc: Project-relative Standard MIDI File to read.
parameters.placeholder: choose a MIDI file in this project

parameters.name: source-file
parameters.doc: Original MIDI retained when an editable variant is created.

parameters.name: variant-file
parameters.doc: Latest MIDI exported from the editable variant.

parameters.name: variant-module
parameters.doc: Generated project module edited as this block's variant.

parameters.name: track
parameters.placeholder: all or a zero-based track number
parameters.doc: Select every track or one zero-based track number.

parameters.name: bars
parameters.doc: Length of the MIDI block in bars.

parameters.name: limiter
parameters.doc: Integer soft limiter for MIDI audio; off keeps hard clipping.

parameters.name: channels
parameters.doc: auto: stereo when an input or the source is stereo, otherwise mono; mono: sum to mono; stereo: always two channels (a mono sound is copied to both).

needs: A Standard MIDI File (.mid) of the project (parameter file).
